name: NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading — Ratio MA Crossover
description: Market-neutral pairs trading strategy for NVDA and AMD using the NVDA/AMD price ratio moving average crossover as the signal. Computes 20-day and 60-day SMA of the ratio. When the 20d MA crosses below the 60d MA (AMD gaining relative strength), goes LONG AMD / SHORT NVDA. When the 20d MA crosses back above the 60d MA, reverses to LONG NVDA / SHORT AMD. Always in a position with 50% long / 50% short for dollar-neutral execution.
source:
# NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading — Ratio MA Crossover
# Signal: NVDA/AMD price ratio with dual SMA crossover
#
# RULES:
# - Compute NVDA/AMD price ratio daily
# - 20-day SMA and 60-day SMA of the ratio
# - 20d crosses BELOW 60d → LONG AMD, SHORT NVDA (AMD gaining relative strength)
# - 20d crosses ABOVE 60d → LONG NVDA, SHORT AMD (NVDA gaining relative strength)
# - Always in position — flips on each crossover (no flat periods)
# - Dollar-neutral: 50% long + 50% short

# --- Reference Data ---
# Load NVDA and AMD price data for ratio computation on all assets
nvda_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="NVDA")()
amd_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="AMD")()

nvda_close = nvda_ref.c
amd_close = amd_ref.c

# --- Price Ratio & Moving Averages ---
# NVDA/AMD price ratio
ratio = nvda_close / amd_close

# Dual SMA on the ratio
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20)(ratio)
ratio_ma60 = ma(period=60)(ratio)

# --- Signal Logic ---
# 20d MA crosses BELOW 60d MA → ratio declining → AMD gaining relative strength
# Action: LONG AMD, SHORT NVDA
amd_strong = crossunder(ratio_ma20, ratio_ma60)

# 20d MA crosses ABOVE 60d MA → ratio rising → NVDA gaining relative strength
# Action: LONG NVDA, SHORT AMD
nvda_strong = crossover(ratio_ma20, ratio_ma60)

# Persist signal state: hold AMD-strong regime until NVDA-strong fires (and vice versa)
amd_regime = hold_until()(enter=amd_strong, exit=nvda_strong)
nvda_regime = hold_until()(enter=nvda_strong, exit=amd_strong)

# --- Per-Asset Direction ---
# Determine which asset we're running on
is_nvda = is_asset_ref(ticker="NVDA")()
is_amd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AMD")()

# NVDA: long in nvda_regime, short in amd_regime
# AMD: long in amd_regime, short in nvda_regime
long_entry = (is_nvda and nvda_regime) or (is_amd and amd_regime)
short_entry = (is_nvda and amd_regime) or (is_amd and nvda_regime)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Dollar-neutral: 50% of equity on each leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
